headline: Middle East Conflict Pushes Oil Prices Above $100; Economists Worry Fuel Shortages Will Hit Inflation
summary: Global oil prices surged on rising Middle East geopolitical tensions, with Brent crude above $100 a barrel. Economists warn that fuel shortages could feed into inflation.
why: Brent crude is the main global benchmark for oil prices, which feed through to transport, industrial costs and consumer inflation. Middle East supply risks are a recurring driver of crude price spikes.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Brent crude rose above $100 on Middle East geopolitical tensions, the event the story reports.
